title: Presheaves of R-modules on a site: sectionwise exactness, and sheafification is exact and commutes with homology
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $R$ a ring. Let $\mathrm{PMod}_R(\mathcal C)$ be the category of presheaves of $R$-modules on $\mathcal C$, $\Mod_R(\mathcal C)$ its full subcategory of sheaves, and $\mathcal P\mapsto\mathcal P^\#$ the sheafification $\mathrm{PMod}_R(\mathcal C)\to\Mod_R(\mathcal C)$, left adjoint to the inclusion [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Then: (1) $\mathrm{PMod}_R(\mathcal C)$ and $\Mod_R(\mathcal C)$ are abelian categories, and for every object $V$ of $\mathcal C$ the evaluation functor $\mathcal P\mapsto\mathcal P(V)$ from $\mathrm{PMod}_R(\mathcal C)$ to $R$-modules is exact; in particular for a complex $\mathcal P_\bullet$ of presheaves of $R$-modules the $i$-th homology presheaf is $V\mapsto H_i(\mathcal P_\bullet(V))$, and a morphism of complexes of presheaves inducing isomorphisms $H_i(\mathcal P_\bullet(V))\to H_i(\mathcal Q_\bullet(V))$ for all $V$ induces an isomorphism of $i$-th homology presheaves; (2) sheafification is exact (it preserves finite limits, and all colimits as a left adjoint); hence for every complex $\mathcal P_\bullet$ of presheaves of $R$-modules there is an isomorphism $H_i(\mathcal P_\bullet^\#)\cong H_i(\mathcal P_\bullet)^\#$ of sheaves of $R$-modules, natural in $\mathcal P_\bullet$, where $\mathcal P_\bullet^\#$ is the complex of sheaves obtained by sheafifying termwise.
